fullContentHtml:
Bihar BTSC Fishery Extension Officer Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Technical Services Commission (BTSC) has recently released the official notification for the recruitment of Fishery Extension Officer posts on its official website. This recruitment has been issued for 787 posts. The online application process for Bihar BTSC Fishery Extension Officer Recruitment 2026 has started on 24 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 23 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for the Bihar BTSC Fishery Extension Officer Online Form 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 September 2026
  • Last Date : 23 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • For All Candidates : Rs 100/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Bihar BTSC Fishery Extension Officer Online Form 2026?

Bihar BTSC Fishery Extension Officer Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
